title: Violet is Blue Too
start: Talk to Postie Pete by the portal to the Land of Snow in Taverley, near White Wolf Mountain.

rewards.t: Lamp of joy, granting 4,000 experience in a skill of choice
rewards.l: Lamp of joy (Violet is Blue Too)

rewards.t: Lamp of wonder, granting 4,000 experience in a skill of choice
rewards.l: Lamp of wonder (Violet is Blue Too)

rewards.t: Lamp of laughter, granting 4,000 experience in a skill of choice
rewards.l: Lamp of laughter (Violet is Blue Too)

rewards.t: Fairylight necklace and its cosmetic override
Fairylight whip and its cosmetic override

steps.t: Talk to Postie Pete at the Land of Snow portal. [Chat: Accept]
Enter the portal.
Talk to Posty and watch the cutscene. [Chat: ~]
Go north up the hill to Violet's house.
Knock on the door.
Progress through the dialogue.
Talk to Violet in her room, north-west of Betty and Trevor.
Search the chest in the eastern side of the room with Betty and Trevor.
Search the rug in Violet's room.
Search the fireplace in the western side of the room with Betty and Trevor.
Search the barrel of fish under the stairs.
p: Place: Barrel of fish (Land of Snow)

steps.t: Progress through the dialogue with Violet. [Chat: 2 What should we do?]
Exit the house and talk to Violet. [Chat: ~]
Talk to one of the snow imps.
Go south to the abandoned farm.
Open the chest by the door.
Proceed through dialogue with the snow imp follower (whose name is randomly selected). [Chat: 3 At least you got out before Christmas.]
Talk to Assistant Brad (north-east of the burning Christmas tree). [Chat: 1 How can we help out?]
p: Arriving in Yeti Town with Violet

steps.t: Go north over the bridge, then west to the Christmas tree farm.
Talk to Taylor north west of the town.
Inspect the wonky tree on the western side of the farm.
Return to the town centre.
Talk to Assistant Brad.
Talk to Assistant Susi south-east of wonky tree.
Knock on 4 doors around town for 4 piles of Christmas decorations:

sub.t: Southern side of the house east of the town centre.
"The Mug-Inn" south-west of the town centre.

steps.t: Talk to Assistant Susi.
Decorate 5 lampposts:

sub.t: 1 further south, on the path to the hill.

steps.t: Decorate 4 houses by using the same door that you knocked on before:

sub.t: Southern side of the house east of the town centre.
"The Mug-Inn" south-west of the town centre.

steps.t: Talk to Assistant Susi.
Talk to Assistant Timothy north-west of the wonky tree.
Talk to Posty, who appears north of the wonky tree.
Talk to the children around the town in the following order:

sub.t: Elizabeth west of the wonky tree.
Mozzie in the south-eastern part of the town.
Neal in the house on the hill in the southern part of the town.

steps.t: Take Santa's 'naughty or nice' list outside the eastern window of the house.
Talk to Posty north of the wonky tree.
Talk to the named snow imp (last name Claus) north of the wonky tree.
Talk to Hal the snow impling just south-west of the wonky tree.
Go up the southern hill and just in front of the house launch the snow impling from your backpack three times.
Admire the wonky tree.
Talk to the named snow imp or Violet.
Talk to Violet.
Knock on the door.
Talk to Betty or Trevor to complete the quest.

p: The tree is replaced, and the town is decorated.
